title: how-it-works closing CTA moved into the last content section
summary: The three how-it-works pages (index, navigation, notebook) no longer wrap their 'Read the docs' / cross-page nav links in a standalone <section class="how-close">; .how-next is appended directly inside the last .how-sec's .wrap, and .how-next now carries its own margin-top (34px) so the buttons never sit flush against whatever content precedes them. Removing the section's own heading/copy/install-command left the button row as an empty, thinly-padded section boxed between two divider lines (its own border-top and the footer's) — folding it into the prior section removes that box entirely instead of just hiding the divider.

steps.role: closing CTA now appended inside the last .how-sec's .wrap instead of its own .how-close section
same fold — closing CTA moved into the 'One repo, one corpus' section
same fold — closing CTA moved into the loop-close section
gives .how-next its own margin-top:34px; drops .how-close's border-top (still used standalone by /vs/vector-rag/)

invariants: Don't reintroduce a standalone <section class="how-close"> around just the button row on these three pages — append .how-next to the prior .how-sec's .wrap instead.
.how-next has no spacing of its own from whatever precedes it beyond its own margin-top (34px) — removing that margin recreates the flush/touching bug.
.how-close's CSS is still alive and used by /vs/vector-rag.astro's own closing section — don't delete the class even though these three pages no longer render it.
